hooks.command: f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); case "$f" in *.env.example) ;; *data*local*|*.env|*.env.*|*.dump|*.age) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"src/data/local, .env files and dumps hold real financial data or secrets. They are never read into a transcript."}}';; esac

f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); case "$f" in *supabase*migrations*.sql) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Migration checklist: RLS enabled on every new table in this same migration, user_id default auth.uid(), unique (user_id, id), composite FKs to other user tables, the aal2 restrictive policy, and a pgTAP test in src/supabase/tests proving another user sees zero rows. Run from src/: supabase db reset && supabase test db && supabase db lint. Update docs/01_building/database.md."}}';; esac

hooks.statusMessage: Checking docs are part of the change
